townRating.rationale: Three stars are retained. The Falls of Dochart are a genuine national-quality landscape anchor, and the Old Mill, Finlarig, food cluster and well-defined trail network give the settlement enough depth for a half or full day without relying on nearby out-of-boundary attractions.

boundaryRule: The official NRS 2022 Killin locality remains the active visitor boundary. Every published marker is inside it. Moirlanich Longhouse and wider Loch Tay or glen attractions are excluded from Killin's town planner. Trail routes may leave the locality after starting at an in-boundary marker.

attractions.name: Falls of Dochart and historic bridge
The Old Mill and St Fillan traditions

excluded.name: Moirlanich Longhouse
excluded.reason: Outside the active NRS Killin locality. It remains a worthwhile nearby attraction but does not appear in the town planner or influence the town rating.

excluded.name: Kinnell Park stone circle
excluded.reason: Its mapped centre falls just outside the active NRS Killin locality. It remains nearby archaeological context and its approach also requires care around private estate and grazing land.

excluded.name: Killin Outdoor Centre hire desk
excluded.reason: Useful activity support but not an attraction in itself; route experiences are represented under Trails instead.

excluded.name: Falls of Dochart Inn and Co-op customer parking
excluded.reason: OSM records customer-only access, so neither is published as public visitor parking.

excluded.name: Golf, cemetery, Pier Road and unnamed edge parking
excluded.reason: Excluded because public access, intended visitor use or current charging terms could not be defended.

excluded.name: Boathouse Kitchen, Moirlanich and wider Loch Tay businesses
excluded.reason: Outside the active settlement polygon and therefore not part of Killin's planner.
